retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1960s soul aesthetic featuring ultra-thin geometric sans-serif typography over a textured dark background with a central warm-toned portrait.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a central, warm-toned (amber/sepia) portrait of a woman with her hands to her face, set against a dark, cracked, stone-like background. The top third is dominated by ultra-thin, wide-set geometric typography that spans the full width.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the warm amber portrait and the cold black textured background
Alignment of the central portrait with the secondary title text
Full-width spanning of the primary headline across the upper margin
Balance between the dense central image and the expansive negative space of the background
coreInvariants: Ultra-thin stroke weight for all display text
Cracked/distressed texture on the black background
Monochromatic amber/orange color grading on the central photograph

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A medium-close portrait centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 40% of the total canvas area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central amber-toned portrait acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large hairline title at the top, drops to the central portrait, then moves to the secondary text and logo below.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark, textured negative space surrounds the central portrait, emphasizing the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal/black with a cracked texture for the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and burnt orange for the central portrait.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the hairline typography and logos.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white text and black background; low saturation except for the warm portrait core.

letterConstructionRules: Tight tracking for the main title to create a horizontal bar effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying sizes and tracking to maintain mid-century consistency.
graphicDevices: Circular logo badge at bottom center
Small metadata text in upper right corner

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric 1960s-70s soul aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and thinness.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a square dark charcoal background with a heavy cracked stone or distressed leather texture. Place a square, amber-toned, high-contrast portrait of a person in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-thin geometric sans-serif text in white. The main title should span the top edge. Add secondary text in a smaller size below the title and a small circular logo at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the main title text ultra-thin and spanning the full width?
Is the central portrait monochromatic amber/orange?
Does the background have a visible cracked texture?

adjustableVariables: Hue of the central portrait (amber vs. sepia)
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or song titles
Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the central portrait box
Verify the 'cracks' look like physical wear, not digital noise
Check that the white text is legible against the dark background
Confirm the portrait is centered and square-cropped
recipe.reuseFormula: Geometric Hairline Sans + Central Amber Portrait + Cracked Black Stone Texture = Mid-Century Soul Aesthetic
